method: Repository API/source-file inspection plus official-page text returned by web search extraction. No GitHub browser or user browser was used.

records.role: Original national ADM2 source for the 34 native-unit subjects and administrative parents from which the 11 ecological pieces were derived.
records.vintage: Represented boundary year 2017; data update 2023-03-03; source build 2023-12-12.
records.license: Open Data Commons Open Database License 1.0; source metadata attributes OpenStreetMap and Wambacher.
records.retention: restoration-only for the full 120,489,189-byte national archive; the 203 scoped original features needed for this Siberia review are retained in the parent packet.
records.limit: The source metadata says 2,328 ADM2 units while its complete archive has 2,327 features. It is historical and does not establish current legal status or boundary completeness.

records.role: Physical ecoregion source used to create the 11 ecological portions; ECO_ID is the verified identity field.
records.vintage: Layer source data last edit 2022-01-27; later schema edits are not a new boundary vintage.
records.license: CC BY 4.0 as listed by the ArcGIS item; underlying source district geometry retains the separate ODbL 1.0 attribution.
records.retention: restoration-only for the national service; the four exact ecoregion features, item record, layer metadata, and query are retained in the parent packet.
records.limit: This dataset is ecological, not an administrative-territory source, and does not validate current province or district boundaries.

records.role: Federal open-data catalog for the All-Russian Classifier of Municipal Territories (OKTMO); official national lead for current municipal names/codes and hierarchy.
records.vintage: Search-indexed catalog lists CSV data-20261001T1110-structure-20260210T1102.csv; catalog last modified 2026-10-01.
records.retrieved_at: 2026-10-06 (official page text returned by web search extraction; raw catalog and CSV not retrieved)
records.license: Catalog states typical terms for publicly available open data, but those terms and the specific file were not inspected; treat reuse status as unverified.
records.retention: restoration-only; no source bytes retained and no source-byte hash claimed.
records.restore: Open https://rosstat.gov.ru/opendata/7708234640-oktmo and download the catalog's 2026-10-01 CSV data-20261001T1110-structure-20260210T1102.csv plus structure-20260210T1102.csv; record final URLs, terms, byte lengths and SHA-256 before relying on rows.
records.access_attempt: A normal TLS-verified curl to the catalog and guessed official CSV endpoint failed with `SSL certificate problem: unable to get local issuer certificate` on 2026-10-06. Certificate checks were not bypassed.
records.limit: Search extraction is a source-discovery lead, not retained source bytes or an inspected CSV. No geographic claim in this packet relies on an unread OKTMO row.

records.role: Official Altai Krai municipal register index. The page describes its linked list as according to regional laws establishing the status and boundaries of municipal and administrative-territorial entities.
records.vintage: Linked DOCX named `Municipal formations of Altai Krai`, catalog date 2026-01-16; official statistical material also reports 2026-01-01 totals.
records.retrieved_at: 2026-10-06 (official page text returned by web search extraction; DOCX not retrieved)
records.license: Specific DOCX reuse terms not inspected.
records.retention: restoration-only; no DOCX bytes or source-byte hash claimed.
records.restore: Open the official page and download the 40.29 KB `Municipal formations of Altai Krai` DOCX listed 2026-01-16; inspect its source-law citations and record the exact file SHA-256.
records.limit: The current DOCX is not retained. The eight city labels have earlier official-statistics support but their 2026 row-level types remain unchecked here. Official Treasury search extraction records Slavgorod's conversion to municipal okrug; its complete current legal roster remains to be inspected.

records.role: Earlier official Rosstat classification of Altai Krai urban and municipal okrugs, useful to compare the 2017 source names.

records.retrieved_at: 2026-10-06 (official PDF text returned by web search extraction; file not retrieved)
records.retention: restoration-only; no PDF bytes or source-byte hash claimed.
records.restore: Download the 2024 yearbook PDF from the listed official Rosstat URL; record final URL, size, terms and SHA-256.

records.role: Official regional MChS profile listing Yamal-Nenets municipal entities under city okrugs and municipal okrugs; it names the four in-scope city entities and seven district-named municipal okrugs.
records.vintage: Original packet HTML capture 2026-10-05 23:10:05 PDT; current official page search extraction crawled two days before 2026-10-06.
records.license: CC BY 4.0 page footer, as recorded in the parent packet.
records.limit: A municipality roster does not supply a component-by-component municipal boundary; the MChS island statement covers some islands only.

records.role: Official regional legislature publication of Law 63-oz, whose subject is the status and boundaries of municipalities and whose Article 1 enumerates city okrugs; annexes include boundary schemes.
records.vintage: Official PDF indexed as the amended text; the page's exact revision date was not inspected. A 2025 amendment is reflected in the official law passport; 2026 amendments were not ruled out.
records.retrieved_at: 2026-10-06 (official PDF metadata/text returned by web search extraction; PDF not retrieved)
records.license: Legal text; reuse terms not inspected. Citation rather than PDF redistribution is planned.
records.retention: restoration-only; no PDF bytes or source-byte hash claimed.
records.restore: Download the legislature-hosted PDF and compare Article 1 plus the separate administrative-territorial law 43-oz; record both exact URLs, publication/revision dates and SHA-256.
records.limit: Municipal city-okrg status is not equivalent to administrative territorial `gorod okrug significance`; exact 2026 statutory state and Annex geometry were not byte-inspected in this run.
